issues.description: findChangedFiles returning null silently disables filtering and reports coverage for all files
issues.detail: When VitestGit.findChangedFiles returns null (not a git repo, bad ref), onTestRunStart sets changedFiles to undefined and isIncluded falls through to reporting coverage on everything. The user asked for changed-only coverage; they get full coverage with no warning. Fail loud or warn.

issues.description: changedFiles path comparison uses raw string equality with no normalization contract
issues.detail: isIncluded compares slash(cleanUrl(filename)) against this.changedFiles.includes(filename), but findChangedFiles returns whatever git emits. On Windows or with absolute/relative mismatches the membership test silently returns false and coverage goes empty. Normalize changedFiles at assignment and document the path-form invariant.

issues.description: globCache key is filename-only but cached value now depends on changedFiles state
issues.detail: isIncluded's postcondition depends on this.changedFiles, set later by onTestRunStart, but the cache is keyed only on filename. Any caller invoking isIncluded before onTestRunStart fires poisons the cache. Either include changedFiles in the key or document and enforce the ordering invariant.

issues.description: CoverageProvider contract widened with optional onTestRunStart that BaseCoverageProvider silently requires
issues.detail: onTestRunStart is declared optional on CoverageProvider, but BaseCoverageProvider relies on it to populate changedFiles. Custom providers that override or omit it silently lose changed-files filtering. Either state the spec explicitly or move the call into a non-overridable lifecycle hook.

issues.description: onTestRunStart hook duplicated at three core.ts call sites instead of folded into start()
issues.detail: core.ts has three identical await this.coverageProvider?.onTestRunStart?.() lines after _testRun.start(...). The ordering invariant is carried only by convention, and the next contributor will forget the fourth call site. Fold into _testRun.start or a helper.

issues.description: CLI transform handles boolean inputs the CLI parser cannot produce
issues.detail: The transform checks value === true and value === false, but CLI args arrive as strings. The dead branches either signal a leaky abstraction between CLI and programmatic config or reveal the contract isn't pinned. Narrow the input type to string or document why bool is reachable.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on a coherent verdict: the feature scope is reasonable but the implementation has unstated invariants at the path-normalization and lifecycle-ordering boundaries. Three concrete correctness issues dominate — silent fallthrough when findChangedFiles returns null, raw string equality on un-normalized paths (a Windows/absolute-vs-relative landmine), and a globCache whose key no longer matches the function its value depends on. Contract hygiene also slipped: onTestRunStart is optional on the interface but mandatory for BaseCoverageProvider's correctness. Action: fail loud on null, normalize paths at assignment, fix the cache key or ordering, fold the hook into start(), and tighten the CLI transform.
